Titanic memorabilia fetches crores at auction

A pocket watch belonging to a Titanic survivor sold for ₹3.17 crore, and a diamond engagement ring from the same survivor fetched ₹1.77 crore at an auction. The engagement ring's sale price was reported as £150,000 in British pounds.
